_comment: Wording of task briefs that prescribes a known anti-pattern of agent-made SA assets (satk.style.brief).
pattern = case-insensitive regular expression on the brief with line breaks joined to spaces; why = what
vanilla does instead (measured); fix = what the brief should say. A brief names the asset, the tier and the
--like model and points to the style help topics; it never restates style numbers.

crisp.why: vanilla textures are small, soft and photo-like (hundreds of colours, painted grime); 'crisp' produces vector-art textures with a few flat colours
crisp.fix: say 'photo-like textures with shading and grime painted in' and cite style_texture

clean_shapes.why: vanilla bodies carry trim, panel lines, lamps and grime in geometry and texture; 'clean shapes' gives bare, under-detailed models
clean_shapes.fix: say 'silhouette first, detail where the outline turns' and cite the class topic

flat_colour.why: vanilla paint is the key colour times vehiclegrunge256 (grain, dirt, height-dependent value) plus the env sheen; map materials are textured and prelit
flat_colour.fix: say 'paint on vehiclegrunge256 with the class colour keys' (vehicles) or 'tiling textures with prelight' (map)

no_photos.why: vanilla textures are photo-sourced; a ban on photographs pushes agents to vector art
no_photos.fix: allow licensed photographs or name the photo-free recipe of style_texture

real_scale.why: SA vehicles are about 1.1-1.2x their real counterparts with real-size wheels; real-world specs made the benchmark car 4.98 m, below every vanilla 4-door
real_scale.fix: say 'scale from the class anchor (wheel size or ped height); the class band decides'

hard_edges.why: vanilla cars are soft (normal bend about 10 deg, about 10 % flat triangles); 83-92 % of their hard edges sit on material or UV seams
hard_edges.fix: say 'smooth inside a material, split normals at seams and designed creases' and cite style_shading

dam_lighter.pattern: _dam\b[^.]{0,60}\b(not more than|no more than|never (more|heavier)( than)?|fewer (triangles )?than|lighter than|less than)\b
dam_lighter.why: vanilla _dam parts are 0.8-1.1x their _ok part; a 'never heavier' rule makes agents decimate the damage states
dam_lighter.fix: say 'damage parts of comparable density' (dam.ok_ratio of the class)

from_nothing.why: rebuilding from scripts made agents hand-type thousands of coordinates; reproducibility comes from the session journal and checkpoints
from_nothing.fix: say 'model in the live Blender session; asset.json, the journal and checkpoints make it reproducible'

budget.why: a triangle floor above the vanilla p50 of the class asks for a heavier model than vanilla without naming the tier
budget.fix: name the tier (sa_plus or vanilla) and let style.profile give the band; do not set triangle floors in the brief
